title: Correct outflow velocity
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate v₀ = 2 m/s using projectile motion equations.

title: Correct tangent value
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly determine tanθ = 2 from the velocity components at impact.

title: Time of flight calculation
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly compute the time of flight (0.4 s) from vertical motion.

title: Velocity components at impact
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly find both horizontal (2 m/s) and vertical (4 m/s) velocity components at ground impact.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important Criteria: Student must properly apply kinematic equations for horizontal and vertical motion separately.

title: Angle interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: Student should recognize that tanθ relates vertical and horizontal velocity components at impact.

title: Sign error in vertical velocity
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly uses negative sign for vertical velocity when calculating tanθ.

title: Confusion with angle reference
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student calculates angle relative to horizontal instead of relative to ground (complementary angle).
